# apply creates an empty file for a declared secret that is missing on disk.
# A dangling symlink looks missing, but creating it would write its target.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

mkdir trap
symlink x.env -> trap/created
exec sh -c 'printf "  - path: x.env\n" >> sesam.yml'
! exec sesam config apply
stderr 'is a symlink'
! exists trap/created
